choices.why: A deep three-seat sofa is the right piece for watching TV, and its charcoal fabric anchors the white walls and light oak floor along the long left wall.
The compact 74 cm square birch table fits the balcony end of this narrow room for eating without blocking the walkway, and its pale wood matches the floor.
The long, low white console is wide enough to balance a three-seat sofa across from it and blends cleanly into the white right wall.
The 133×195 cm speckled cream rug fills the space between sofa and TV stand, and its black flecks tie the dark sofa to the light room.
The white drum-shade lamp gives soft ambient light beside the sofa and suits the minimal white and steel palette.
White linen curtains soften the black-framed sliding door while letting daylight through, staying airy against the white walls.

answer.why: A charcoal sofa and black-flecked rug give contrast, while white storage, lamp and curtains plus pale birch wood echo the white walls and light oak floor. The result is a calm Scandinavian look that keeps the long, narrow room open and bright.
